articles.title_en: MEPs approved a resolution on Czech Television and Czech Radio, calling for predictable financing
articles.lead_en: MEPs on Wednesday approved a resolution calling on the Czech government to revise the draft law on changing the financing of Czech Television and Czech Radio, promoted by the government of Andrej Babiš (ANO). MEPs call on the government to ensure adequate and predictable funding for both media, to ensure transparent legislative discussions on the amendment and to protect against political interference in the work of Czech Television and Czech Radio.
